title: Stop Wasting AI Tokens   This Free Microsoft Tool Saves You 1000s 🤯 #shorts  #ai #chatgpt #aitools
description:
Are you tired of hitting your token limit when analyzing large documents in Claude AI? You are probably wasting thousands of tokens every single time you upload a PDF, Word document, or Excel sheet.

In this video, I reveal a new, completely free tool from Microsoft called MarkItDown. This tool solves the biggest problem with AI document analysis by instantly converting your heavy files into lightweight markdown code.

Here’s how MarkItDown saves you time and tokens:

It instantly strips away unnecessary formatting and background data from PDFs, Word files, Excel sheets, PowerPoints, and even YouTube transcripts.

It converts your files into clean markdown, ensuring Claude only reads the essential text.

You can even install it as an MCP server to automatically convert files before Claude ever reads them!

Stop wasting your AI usage limits. Use MarkItDown to make your document analysis faster, smarter, and incredibly token-efficient.
